title: XSUAA role mismatch with the IDTS user is denied
runtime: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry / AppRouter / XSUAA / HANA Cloud
testCommand: Browser Control authenticated AppRouter fetch to AuthService.me(), followed by node scripts/qa/test-idts110-btp-role-alignment-receipt.mjs .tmp/idts110-btp-role-alignment-receipts.json
actualResult: With platform role IDTS_DEVELOPER and the unchanged mapped IDTS role TESTER, a newly minted XSUAA session made AuthService.me() return HTTP 403 and the safe role-mismatch message. The UI showed the generic account-cannot-access page. IDTS_TESTER was restored and IDTS_DEVELOPER removed; BTP readback returned exactly IDTS_TESTER.
assertions: BTP role readback showed only IDTS_DEVELOPER before login while the mapped IDTS role remained TESTER.
A newly minted XSUAA session returned HTTP 403.
The response exposed no identity internals or HANA diagnostics.
No business mutation request was issued.
limitations: The temporary mismatch existed only for this bounded acceptance and was fully rolled back immediately after HTTP readback.
